opening.argument: The video presents a practical tutorial for setting up and budgeting a Google Ads campaign intended to generate IT or email-support calls. It explicitly states, "today in this video I will show how exactly you can generate email calls using. Google Adwords" and gives a daily budget of 9500 rupees before instructing viewers that "you just need to run this ad and you. Will start getting calls." The accompanying materials show an IT-support webpage and an ad preview containing email-support and password-reset wording alongside a phone number. Those details describe ordinary paid advertising and operational setup. Although the materials include email/password-support language and an unverified suspension-avoidance statement, they do not by themselves establish deceptive intent, credential collection, payment demands, or harmful outcomes.
